Reused root entry board VALID1828 (f332bb to 969636, both check/status exit0) and scoped lint baseline (9f85c4 to c28813, exit0, no diagnostics). baseline_case: Source-confirmed counter rewind: reversed unit frames one tau apart produce 2/e instead of 1+1/e; no new failed runtime baseline claimed. Internal server-stamped async ordering, not browser-clock policy. Missing/coerced/zero regional timestamps can manufacture receipt time.
implementation: applyTrend rejects invalid represented timestamps before any mutation. Valid contributions use existing mergeEntries at max(previous.t, incoming.ts), preserving full internal score precision and nondecreasing per-key time. Cap candidates are evaluated at max(state.updatedAt, frame.ts).

RegionTrend ingress uses existing isEventTimestamp before scope resolution, state load/write or alarm access. Invalid timestamps return fixed safe400; valid numeric zero is preserved. No comparison against server now and no lateness/future/skew cutoff.

Existing weights/touches, per-frame event counts, 32-value cap, epsilon, current generation, tenant/region identity, async host fan-in, coalesced publication and snapshot rounding/shares remain unchanged. No new retained state or I/O.

Exactly two grouped additions in the existing fixture: independent weighted exponential expectations across all permutations of bounded clean unit/weighted/equal-time/epoch cases, monotonic times, direct invalid no-op and common-time cap eviction; actual object malformed ingress with zero effects, zero/maximum-Date preservation, reversed arrivals, independent persisted-byte reload and exact raw/rounded publication checks. Four selected existing controls are unmodified.
